description: Use default capture by reference ([&]) only when the lifetime of the lambda is obviously shorter than any potential captures.

semgrep.limitations: Cannot statically verify lifetime relationships; rule flags all default capture by reference.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires complex lifetime analysis; may have high false positive rate.

description: Overload operators only if their meaning is obvious, unsurprising, and consistent with built-in operators. Do not overload &&, ||, , (comma), or unary &.

semgrep.limitations: requires pattern for specific operator tokens

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to detect discouraged operators

description: Every file should contain license boilerplate appropriate for the project. New files usually should not contain copyright notice or author line.

semgrep.limitations: Requires custom rule with file content matching; not a standard code pattern.

pmd.limitations: Requires custom rule with header detection; language-specific support varies.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to check file content; not a standard dataflow or AST rule.

description: Fall-through from one case label to another must be annotated using `[[fallthrough]];`. Consecutive case labels without code need no annotation.

semgrep.limitations: requires precise detection of non-empty statements between case labels

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to detect missing fallthrough annotation

description: Composition is often more appropriate than inheritance. Use inheritance only for 'is-a' relationships. Limit use of `protected`.

pmd.limitations: requires custom rule for protected field detection

codeql.limitations: requires complex query to assess appropriateness of inheritance

description: Detect use of non-inclusive or offensive terms (e.g., master/slave, blacklist/whitelist) and encourage gender-neutral language.

semgrep.limitations: regex-based matching may have false positives/negatives; does not understand semantic context.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query using string matching; not a built-in rule.

description: Use either `//` or `/* */` comment syntax consistently within the file. `//` is much more common.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to check comment style consistency

description: Use default capture by value ([=]) sparingly. Prefer explicit captures and avoid long lambdas with [=] that may implicitly capture 'this'.

description: Within each include section, includes should be ordered alphabetically.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to check ordering of includes within a section.

description: Do not use C++ exceptions (except Windows code). Use error codes or assertions instead.

semgrep.limitations: Cannot detect Windows-specific exceptions without additional context.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support C/C++ analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to exclude Windows-specific code.

description: Type-use annotations must appear immediately before the annotated type and be meta-annotated with @Target(ElementType.TYPE_USE).

pmd.limitations: requires type resolution to verify @Target meta-annotation

description: Optional grouping parentheses omitted only when author and reviewer agree no reasonable chance of misinterpretation. Example: (a + b) * c recommended over a + b * c unless obvious. Cannot assume reader memorizes operator precedence.

semgrep.limitations: requires manual configuration of operator precedence pairs; may have many false positives

pmd.limitations: PMD does not have a built-in rule for this specific precedence grouping check; requires custom rule

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to encode operator precedence rules

description: After a comma following an enum constant, a line break is optional. Additional blank lines (usually one) are allowed.

semgrep.limitations: Formatting rule not suitable for code pattern detection.

pmd.limitations: Requires custom rule for whitespace/formatting.

codeql.limitations: Formatting rule not suitable for semantic analysis.

description: In rare circumstances (e.g., multipart version numbers), use underscores to separate adjacent numbers in identifiers. Numbers have no case variants.

semgrep.limitations: requires regex pattern to detect adjacent numbers, may have false positives

pmd.limitations: requires custom rule to check identifier naming convention

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to detect identifier patterns with adjacent numbers

description: In a module-info.java file, the 'transitive' modifier must appear before the 'static' modifier in a requires directive.

pmd.limitations: Requires custom rule implementation for Java module syntax.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query for Java module syntax.

description: A single blank line should appear between consecutive members or initializers of a class.

semgrep.limitations: Requires custom rule using metavariable-comparison for line numbers; may have false positives with comments.

pmd.limitations: PMD's EmptyLineSeparator rule can be configured for this check.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query using location information.

description: TODO comments must begin with TODO in all caps, followed by a colon, a link to a resource (preferably a bug reference), a hyphen, and an explanatory string.

semgrep.limitations: requires pattern matching for comment syntax

pmd.limitations: PMD does not have a built-in rule for TODO comment format; requires custom rule

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for comment formatting

description: Annotations applying to class, package, or module must appear immediately after the documentation block, one per line, without extra indentation.

semgrep.limitations: pattern may not capture all annotation ordering variations

pmd.limitations: requires custom rule for annotation formatting

codeql.limitations: CodeQL is not designed for formatting rule enforcement

description: If a word already has conventional camel-case appearance (e.g., 'AdWords'), split into constituent parts ('ad words'). Does not apply to 'iOS'.

semgrep.limitations: regex-based detection only; may have false positives/negatives on complex identifiers

pmd.limitations: requires custom rule implementation for specific camel-case splitting logic

codeql.limitations: requires custom query to implement the specific splitting convention and 'iOS' exception

description: When an exception is caught and no action is taken, a comment explaining the reason must be present.

semgrep.limitations: Semgrep can detect empty catch blocks but comment detection is limited to pattern matching.

codeql.limitations: CodeQL can find empty catch blocks, but precise detection of explanatory comments requires custom query logic.

description: Empty catch blocks must contain a comment explaining why the exception is ignored. Doing nothing in a catch block is rarely correct.

semgrep.limitations: Comment detection may be limited to simple patterns; may not detect all comment styles.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis.

codeql.limitations: Requires custom query to check for comments within empty blocks.

description: Enumerations defined by adding `@enum` annotation to an object literal. Must be module-local or on `exports`. Values must be string literals or numbers. No additional properties after definition; must be constant.

semgrep.limitations: requires type resolution for @enum annotation and constant detection

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for JSDoc @enum annotation patterns

description: Array literals must include a trailing comma when there is a line break between the final element and the closing bracket.

semgrep.limitations: requires precise detection of line breaks and bracket position

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for formatting rule

description: Arrow function body should be a block or a single expression. Use `void` before a single function call if no return value is needed.

semgrep.limitations: requires precise AST matching for `void` and block detection

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

codeql.limitations: requires custom query for `void` usage pattern

description: Computed properties in classes should only be used when the property key is a Symbol. Dict-style properties (quoted strings or computed non-symbol expressions) are not allowed.

semgrep.limitations: Pattern may match valid Symbol keys; requires additional constraint to exclude Symbol.iterator etc.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis.

description: Local variables should be declared close to their first use, not at the start of a block, to minimize their scope. They should be initialized as soon as possible.

semgrep.limitations: Pattern may match across non-consecutive statements; requires precise scope analysis for accuracy.

pmd.limitations: PMD has a rule 'LocalVariableCouldBeFinal' and similar scope rules, but not an exact match for declaration distance.

codeql.limitations: Can be expressed via data flow and control flow, but requires custom query for declaration-to-first-use distance.

description: Function calls should use the spread operator `...` instead of `Function.prototype.apply`. No space should appear after the `...`.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis

description: Abstract classes and methods should be annotated with `@abstract`. Do not use `goog.abstractMethod`.

pmd.limitations: PMD does not support JavaScript analysis.

description: Use template literals `...` over complex string concatenation, especially with multiple literals. May span multiple lines.

description: Always throw `Error` or subclasses; never throw string literals or other objects. Always use `new Error()`. Applies to `Promise.reject` as well.

description: Check that comments use proper punctuation, spelling, and grammar, including complete sentences with correct capitalization.
